newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia meets coal miners over contract of work.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia meets coal miners over contract of work.

text.p: Coal mining companies were on Thursday briefed by a senior mining official on a new contract of work for the industry, officials and industry sources said.
They said the contract was aimed at bringing the coal sector in line with mineral mining, and that the briefing was held by the director of coal mining, Soedjokotirto Soekotjo.
"Mr Soedjoko gave a briefing this morning to coal mining companies about the contract of work," an official at the department of coal mining told Reuters.
Industry officials said the contract had yet to be approved by parliament.

The mines and energy ministry has proposed sweeping changes to its mineral mining regulations, including requiring foreign companies to allocate a 10 percent stake to the government in future projects.
Industry officials were critical of the move, saying it could dampen the investment climate.
